cards.title: Use conversational messaging to resolve product-purchase friction
cards.summary: When shoppers need help with product fit, compatibility or a cart decision.
cards.use_when: When shoppers need help with product fit, compatibility or a cart decision.
steps: Audit messages for a concrete question the shopper can answer easily.
Identify the store and use natural, clear language rather than pretending an automated message is a personal friend.
Route replies to someone able to answer product, delivery and returns questions.
Use the supported messaging channel for the recipient; do not assume blue bubbles improve every audience.
caveats: The source promotes an iMessage tool; its claimed channel advantage is not independently established.
cards.source_name: If I Started SMS Marketing in 2026, I'd Do This.docx

cards.title: Reduce signup fields while retaining clear messaging consent
cards.summary: When simplifying a store text-message signup form.
cards.use_when: When simplifying a store text-message signup form.
steps: Collect only information needed for this signup and a useful follow-up.
Keep the marketing permission and sender purpose clear; a phone number alone is not the marketing opt-in.
Do not remove information the checkout needs to fulfill the order.
Compare signup completion with downstream replies, purchases and opt-outs.
caveats: Merchant adaptation of the source form-friction principle.
cards.source_name: If I Started SMS Marketing in 2026, I'd Do This.docx

cards.title: Test concise conversational welcome messages
cards.summary: When welcoming a shopper who opted into the store messaging program.
cards.use_when: When welcoming a shopper who opted into the store messaging program.
steps: Deliver any promised signup benefit and identify the store.
Ask one useful question about product preferences or intended use if a response will change the help offered.
The source suggests a five-minute delay and short copy; test timing within applicable send-time and message-count controls.
Do not split one message into several merely to simulate a human or satisfy an arbitrary length limit.
caveats: The source five-minute and 80-character preferences are heuristics, not optimal limits or billing rules.
cards.source_name: If I Started SMS Marketing in 2026, I'd Do This.docx

cards.title: Hand product questions to a trained human
cards.summary: When a messaging flow receives replies requiring individualized help.
cards.use_when: When a messaging flow receives replies requiring individualized help.
steps: Route replies to the support or product-specialist queue.
Carry forward the relevant product and order context so the shopper does not repeat it.
Answer the question and offer the appropriate product, size guide or cart link.
Set a realistic response target and communicate availability.
caveats: Human support requires staffing; the source response-rate anecdotes do not establish purchase uplift.
cards.source_name: If I Started SMS Marketing in 2026, I'd Do This.docx

cards.title: Use short product demos to answer a shopper question
cards.summary: When a opted-in conversation needs a clearer product explanation than text.
cards.use_when: When a opted-in conversation needs a clearer product explanation than text.
steps: Choose a short product demonstration or voice explanation only when the channel and shopper support it.
Use the actual SKU and answer the specific question.
Provide a text alternative when media is inaccessible or unavailable.
Compare resolution and purchase outcomes with text-only support against production effort.
caveats: Merchant application of the source multimedia conversation idea; channel capabilities and costs differ.
cards.source_name: If I Started SMS Marketing in 2026, I'd Do This.docx

cards.title: Measure conversational messaging by purchases and support outcomes
cards.summary: When evaluating store messaging flows or comparing supported channels.
cards.use_when: When evaluating store messaging flows or comparing supported channels.
steps: Track delivery, replies, opt-outs, support resolution, purchases and net contribution after messaging cost.
Use consistent attribution windows and a comparable control when estimating incremental impact.
Separate product inquiries from service appointment show-up or sales-call close rates.
Treat the source reported twofold reply lift as an unverified vendor example, not expected purchase lift.
caveats: Replies alone do not establish revenue impact.
cards.source_name: If I Started SMS Marketing in 2026, I'd Do This.docx

editorial_review: Retained merchant conversational applications; removed unsupported opt-out omission and service-call tactics.
